meta.title: اختبار الفصل الأول في اللغة الإنجليزية

paper:
Hi! My name is Lina. This is my classroom. It is big and clean. My school bag is under the table. My green pencil is in the pencil case. My red book is on the desk. I love my school!

Exercise 1 (3 points)

Read and answer: a) Is the classroom big? b) Where is the school bag? c) What colour is the book?

Exercise 2 (3 points)

Complete with: in – on – under

The cat is …… the box (inside). — The pen is …… the table (on top). — The ball is …… the chair (below).

Exercise 3 (2 points)

Match: 1) a ruler   2) an eraser   → a) to rub out mistakes   b) to draw lines

Exercise 4 (2 points)

Write two sentences about your school bag (colour + one thing inside).
